title: ELISA Protocol: Substrate and Stop Solution Addition
author: Opentrons
materials: This is the third part of a ELISA protocol: Substrate and Stop Solution Addition. This should be run immediately after the incubation and wash steps. Download full protocol details [here](https://s3.amazonaws.com/opentrons-protocol-library-website/custom-README-images/1464-natrix-separations-inc-milliporesigma/NEW_ELISA_protocol.xlsx). --- You will need: * P300 Multi-channel Pipette * P300 Single-channel Pipette * [Opentrons Tube Racks (2 mL Eppendorf)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [Opentrons Tube Rack (15 + 50 mL)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * 96-well Plate * 12-row Trough * 300 uL Tip Racks
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect a P300 multi‑channel pipette, a P300 single‑channel pipette, Opentrons 2 mL Eppendorf tube racks, an Opentrons 15 mL + 50 mL tube rack, a 96‑well plate, a 12‑row trough, and 300 µL tip racks.

steps.title: Enter occupied columns
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the number of columns that are currently occupied in the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the full ELISA protocol (Substrate and Stop Solution Addition) from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the supplied deck map, placing the 96‑well plate, 12‑row trough, tube racks, and tip racks in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tip racks, and both P300 pipettes (refer to the calibration support article for tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the substrate and stop‑solution addition step (to be performed immediately after the incubation and wash steps).
